statement: Four workers on four different questions converged on one property: every gate this programme relied on certified PRESENCE, not CORRESPONDENCE.
The drift gate checks that each pin matches the file it points at, not that the governed surfaces agree with each other. A clean gate reads as agreement and is not.

The compiler checks that ids and locators are present and legal, not that an acceptance belongs to the capability citing it. Four capabilities cited ACC-SBL_SHARED_CORE and every compiler stage passed.
A lane probe proves a model served; it does not prove an SP was invoked. The dispatcher binds models, not SPs, and no inspected path calls commander_sp, external_challenge_sp or sign_verdict.

selftest 9/9 proves a local M01/M02/M03 journey, not the governed native chain; ROOT_READY 6/6 proves paths exist and a package imports, not native admission; "14 components" proves 14 hashes exist, not 14 qualified capabilities.

The semantic denominator of DOC-00..13 is UNKNOWN and the package says so itself: DOC-02 L128 D_clause_semantic=UNRESOLVED; DOC-04 L99 semantic_source_clauses_total=NOT_ESTABLISHED; DOC-12 L7829 global denominator UNKNOWN.

What IS countable: 4738 document-qualified requirement records, 4589 distinct requirement ids, 1341 linked ACC ids, 17473442 bytes, 75630 lines. A selected-register inventory, not the semantic contract.

Four runtime_readiness capabilities pointed at a shared acceptance instead of their own. A mis-binding, not a missing binding: the ACC ids already existed, so the fix changed pointers and left all 34 edges untouched.
The SBL repository held no copy of, or pointer to, the control package it implements. The contract was authoritative and untraceable at the same time.
HG-KSEOS lifecycle.py _repo_head() resolves HEAD from the process CWD rather than the project repo, and swallows InvariantViolation. Not fixed this round; carried as R9-06 with the reason recorded.
Three HG-KSEOS test files are untracked at HEAD, so a clean checkout cannot reproduce the reported 580/16. Not fixed: staging another party's uncommitted code would misattribute authorship.

Installation is five separable achievements, only three of which hold: package install, standalone bootstrap, adapter files. Effective Host installation and native integration do not hold, and the ABI itself declares native_effect/permit_signing/workorder_admission as not_provided.
PLAN and VERIFY both serve gpt-6.1-sol, so no model diversity reviews planning artefacts; and model-level separation of duties is not principal-level separation of duties. Disclosed, not fixed.
FABRIC has no SBL install target. None was manufactured to make a five-plane claim look complete.
